description: This file contains a unit test for the QueueType class, testing basic queue operations such as insertion, removal, extraction, and control functions like enable, disable, and flush. It uses Google Test framework for testing.

classes.name: QueueType
classes.description: A template class representing a queue data structure used in the core utilities, instantiated here with int.

methods.name: Insert
methods.description: Inserts an element into the queue with a specified priority.

methods.name: Post
methods.description: Posts the queue, potentially signaling that new data is available.

methods.name: Remove
methods.description: Removes an element from the queue.

methods.name: Extract
methods.description: Extracts an element from the queue, retrieving the data if available.

methods.name: Length
methods.description: Returns the current number of elements in the queue.

methods.name: Enable
methods.description: Enables the queue, allowing operations to proceed.

methods.name: Disable
methods.description: Disables the queue, preventing further operations.

methods.name: Flush
methods.description: Clears all elements from the queue.
